title: Aniko's Nameplate Addon
description: This mod is a small addon to Aniko's Roleplay Mod that allows certain client-side features that aren't possible with the server-side main mod. Will occasionally be updated.
body:
This mod is a small addon to Aniko's Roleplay Mod that allows certain client-side features that aren't possible with the server-side main mod. Will occasionally be updated.

Currently makes

Character names displayed above players

Character names displayed in tab list

Character names update when switching characters

[IC] tag

[CIC] tag

[OOC] tag

[AFK] tag

/IC (In character)

/CIC (Can be in character)

/ooc (Out of character)

/afk (Away from keyboard)

/hidetag (hides tags)

/hidenames (hides usernames)
